plain: Baby steps, updated as they happen. Each line is one concrete thing being done right now; done lines stay for the day so you can see the trail.

steps.text: Verified the NFL API port live: real game detail, rosters, labels merged by play id; milestone 1 closed
Film on an external SSD: configurable film root, mount guard, fz-film add
First real probe: both renditions 244,505 frames, frame-aligned
Film-window detector rewritten around motion and brightness; matches the hand-found answer on the snow game
49ers–Rams (clear game) registered, probed, film window found, proxy built, official plays pulled, 406 takes found
Camera-angle labelling does not transfer between games with the hand-tuned feature; two replacements failed
Milestone 2, first task: contact-sheet review of takes and a tiny learned angle classifier
Spike-based cut detection (a cut is a spike against its neighbours, not an absolute level)
Milestone 2: measure SAM 3 throughput on the M4
Milestone 2: camera-angle classifier from contact-sheet labels (GRD-93)
